name: Should I keep at least one bathtub in my home?

mainEntity.name: Should I keep at least one bathtub in my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether to keep a tub depends on your household routine and future selling plans. Replacing your only bathtub with a walk-in shower can make bathing small children or pets inconvenient and might narrow your buyer pool when selling. However, if your home has at least one other full bathroom with a tub, converting a primary or guest tub into a spacious, accessible walk-in shower improves daily utility and modernizes your living space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, keeping at least one tub in the house is recommended for bathing young children, washing pets, and maintaining resale appeal for future buyers.
